items.name: fl_asar
items.description: Extracts, inspects, and audits Electron ASAR archive packages. Verifies entry byte size integrity against header declarations, extracts package.json manifest, and maps security flags (nodeIntegration, contextIsolation, sandbox, preload).

items.name: fl_bin_inspect
items.description: Fast native binary layout and security mitigations triage for ELF, PE, and Mach-O binaries. Inspects architecture, headers, segments, dynamic symbols, dependencies, and security mitigations (NX/DEP, Stack Canary, PIE/ASLR, RELRO).

items.name: fl_sourcemap
items.description: Offline JavaScript/TypeScript source map resolver. Maps minified tokens, variable names, and line/column offsets back to original source files and source lines from .map files without requiring internet or browser.
